{{Quote|Klaud, I hope you've fixed that surge.|Poe Dameron|<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref>}}
'''Klaud''' was a [[Trodatome]] [[Gender|male]] [[Technician|mechanic]] who worked during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. Hapless and helpful, Klaud was initially brought into the Resistance by mistake, but he happily began assisting with their mechanical needs. Klaud accompanied [[Poe Dameron]], [[Finn]], [[Chewbacca]], and [[R2-D2]] on a [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|mission]] to the [[Sinta Glacier Colony]] aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]].'' The [[starship]] came under attack from [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]]s and [[TIE/wi Interceptor]]s while Klaud made efforts to fix a power surge onboard, and he became overwhelmed by the chase that ensued. [[Pilot]]ing the ''Falcon'', Dameron eventually managed to escape the First Order, returning with the intelligence to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on [[Ajan Kloss]]. Following the [[Battle of Exegol]], Klaud celebrated and was embraced by [[Beaumont Kin]].

==Biography==
[[File:KlaudUWotM8.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Klaud and Temmin Wexley on Ajan Kloss]]
Klaud was a [[Trodatome]]. During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], Klaud worked as a [[Technician|mechanic]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> He was eventually brought into the Resistance thanks to a case of mistaken identity,<ref name="Magnet book">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Book and Magnetic Playset]]''</ref> but he was nevertheless welcomed into its ranks<ref name="Klaud">{{Databank|klaud|Klaud}}</ref> and joined its [[Engineering Corps]].<ref name="TROS Expanded" /> By [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Klaud was stationed at the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] of the main Resistance cell<ref name="Episode IX" /> on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> At one point during his time in the base, Klaud was with [[Resistance pilot]] [[Temmin Wexley]], who gestured at the Trodatome in confusion.<ref name="Klaud" /> Eventually, the Resistance was contacted by [[Boolio]], a [[Mining|mine]] overseer at the [[Sinta Glacier Colony]] who had acquired information from an anonymous high-[[Military rank|ranking]] [[First Order officer]]. As Boolio did not want to risk revealing the intelligence, Boolio claimed that he could provide a regulator required for the Resistance's [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]''.<ref name="TROS VD" />

The Resistance sent several operatives on the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' to meet with Boolio. As the [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|mission]] was believed to be a parts pickup, Klaud accompanied [[Poe Dameron]], [[Finn]], [[Chewbacca]], and the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] aboard the ''Falcon''.<ref name="TROS VD" /> Dameron had requested [[Rey Skywalker|Rey's]] help instead but was overruled by General Leia in favor of Klaud. None of the other members of the crew could understand Klaud, but since he displayed talent for mechanicals, Poe assigned him to continue repairing the ship.<ref name="TROS JN">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> While the ''Falcon'' was on its way to the [[Sinta Glacier]], Klaud made some repairs to the [[freighter]]. The ''Falcon'' arrived at the colony, where Boolio transferred the First Order intelligence to R2-D2. Before the Resistance operatives could depart, however, a number of First Order TIE/sf space superiority starfighters and TIE/wi Interceptors approached the colony, chasing the ''Falcon'' through the [[Water|icy]] corridors of the Sinta Glacier.<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

As the ''Falcon'' navigated the corridors, Klaud was surprised by the chase and was knocked aside by the sharp turns the ship made. Cornered by First Order [[TIE series|TIEs]], Dameron chose to [[Hyperspace skipping|lightspeed skip]] away from the Sinta Glacier, placing the ''Falcon'' into a number of dangerous locations,<ref name="Episode IX" /> including the [[Megafauna Chasm]] of the [[Typhonic Nebula]], the [[Mirror-Spires]] of [[Ivexia]], and the [[Crystal Chaos]] of [[Cardovyte]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> The heavily damaged ''Falcon'' eventually managed to evade its First Order pursuers and returned to the Resistance base<ref name="Episode IX" /> on Ajan Kloss.<ref name="TROS VD" />

Boolio's intelligence revealed that [[Darth Sidious]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor]] who was presumed dead<ref name="Episode IX" /> during the [[Battle of Endor]] [[Standard decade|decades]] earlier,<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> was alive and had been plotting his return to power from the hidden [[Sith]] world of [[Exegol]]. Klaud was present in the Resistance briefing where Dameron and Finn plotted the [[Battle of Exegol]] with the rest of the Resistance fighters. The battle was a success, resulting in the death of Darth Sidious and the destruction of the [[Sith Eternal]]. Klaud took part in the celebration on Ajan Kloss when the victorious Resistance returned, in which he and [[Beaumont Kin]] shared a hug.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Personality and traits==
A hapless [[Trodatome]] [[Gender|male]], Klaud was eager to help the Resistance. However, when the mission to the Sinta Glacier that was believed to be a parts pickup turned into an intelligence operation and an escape from TIE fighters, Klaud was overwhelmed. He was bewildered by the [[human]] [[Resistance pilot]] [[Temmin Wexley]], who was unable to translate Klaud's confusing [[language]]. Klaud had [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s and primarily yellow skin.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Skills and abilities==
Klaud had a keen mind and a talent for the mechanical, using his skills to assist the Resistance. He spoke a complex language that was difficult to understand.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KlaudFinnLaugh.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Klaud's character model and [[John Boyega]] on the set of Episode IX]]
Klaud is a character created for the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'']]. He was introduced by director [[J.J. Abrams]] during the Episode IX panel at [[Celebration Chicago]] 2019.<ref name="Episode IX panel">{{SWYouTube|RnhiLZOprZE|Star Wars: Episode IX Panel | Star Wars Celebration Chicago 2019}}</ref> Klaud was performed by [[Nick Kellington]], who wore a full-body suit with animatronic features that were remotely operated.<ref name="TROS VD" />
